ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The attached figure is a switching circuit. Position 1 of switch S is connected to the upper end of the left voltage source V; position 2 is connected to the upper end of a vertical resistor R, and the lower end of this resistor is connected to the bottom common node. The moving terminal of the switch is connected to the left end of the upper capacitor C, and the right end of the capacitor is connected to the central node. The central node is connected downward through inductor L to the bottom common node; there is also a branch on the right side, from the central node through resistor R and then through capacitor C to the bottom common node. In the figure, i1(t) is marked in the left loop, and i2(t) is marked in the right loop. Reasoning: When the switch has been in position 1 for a long time, it is in DC steady state, the capacitors are open circuits, and the inductor is a short circuit. The central node is shorted to ground by the inductor, but because the upper capacitor is an open circuit, the power source has no DC path to supply power to the inductor, so the initial current of the inductor is 0. The left plate of the upper capacitor is connected to the upper end of the power source, and the right plate is equivalently grounded through the inductor, so its initial voltage is v_A - v_B = V. There is no DC current in the branch where the right-side capacitor is located, and there is finally no voltage across its two ends, so the initial voltage of the right-side capacitor is 0. After switching to position 2 at t = 0+, the capacitor voltages and inductor current cannot change abruptly. Thus the upper capacitor is equivalent to a voltage source satisfying v_A - v_B = V; the initial voltage of the right-side capacitor is 0, so it is equivalent to a short circuit; the initial current of the inductor is 0, so it is equivalent to an open circuit. At this time, node A is connected to ground through the left resistor R, and node B is connected to ground through the right resistor R. Write KCL for the supernode containing A and B: V_A/R + V_B/R = 0, and at the same time V_A - V_B = V. Solving gives V_A = V/2, V_B = -V/2. The actual current in the left resistor flows from A downward to ground, with magnitude V_A/R = V/(2R). Since the positive direction of i1 is taken as upward through the left resistor, opposite to the actual direction, i1(0+) = -V/(2R).

raw_record.question_text: Assume that the switch \( S \) is in position 1 for a long time and thrown to position 2 at \( t = 0 \). What is the current \( i_1 \) at \( t = 0^+ \)?

method.method_draft: First determine the initial stored quantities with S at position 1 for a long time. The central inductor shorts the central node to ground, while both capacitors are open, so the top capacitor has voltage V from its left plate to its right plate, the right capacitor has zero voltage, and the inductor current is zero. Immediately after switching to position 2, keep these values: model the top capacitor as a voltage source with v_A - v_B = V, the right capacitor as a short, and the inductor as an open. Then node A is connected to ground through the left R, and node B is connected to ground through the right R. Apply KCL to the supernode containing A and B: V_A/R + V_B/R = 0, together with V_A - V_B = V. Solve to get V_A = V/2. Since positive i1 is upward through the left resistor, opposite the actual downward current V_A/R, i1(0+) = -V/(2R).

图像描述：附图是一个开关电路。开关 S 的位置 1 连接到左侧电压源 V 的上端；位置 2 连接到一个竖直电阻 R 的上端，该电阻下端接到底部公共节点。开关动端连接到上方电容 C 的左端，电容右端连接到中央节点。中央节点向下通过电感 L 接到底部公共节点；右侧还有一支路，从中央节点经电阻 R 再经电容 C 接到底部公共节点。图中 i1(t) 标在左侧回路，i2(t) 标在右侧回路。

推理：开关在位置 1 很久时为直流稳态，电容开路、电感短路。中央节点被电感短接到地，但由于上方电容开路，电源没有直流通路给电感供电，所以电感初始电流为 0。上方电容左板接电源上端，右板经电感等效接地，因此其初始电压为 v_A - v_B = V。右侧电容所在支路无直流电流，且其两端最终无电压，所以右侧电容初始电压为 0。

在 t = 0+ 切到位置 2 后，电容电压和电感电流不能突变。于是上方电容等效为满足 v_A - v_B = V 的电压源；右侧电容初始电压为 0，等效为短路；电感初始电流为 0，等效为开路。此时节点 A 通过左侧电阻 R 接地，节点 B 通过右侧电阻 R 接地。对包含 A、B 的超节点列 KCL：V_A/R + V_B/R = 0，同时有 V_A - V_B = V。解得 V_A = V/2，V_B = -V/2。左侧电阻中实际电流从 A 向下流向地，大小为 V_A/R = V/(2R)。由于 i1 的正方向取为通过左侧电阻向上，与实际方向相反，所以 i1(0+) = -V/(2R)。

method.method_draft: From the pre-switch steady state, find the same initial conditions: the top capacitor is charged to V, the right capacitor voltage is 0, and the inductor current is 0. At t=0+, write mesh relations instead of node equations. Since the inductor is the common branch and its current cannot jump from zero, the opposing mesh currents through it must be equal: i1(0+) = i2(0+). Now write KVL around the outer path that contains the left position-2 resistor R, the initially charged top capacitor, the right resistor R, and the initially uncharged right capacitor. With the indicated clockwise mesh directions, the equation is R i1 + V + R i2 + 0 = 0. Substituting i2 = i1 gives 2R i1 + V = 0, hence i1(0+) = -V/(2R).

推理：开关 S 在位置 1 很长时间时，电路达到直流稳态。按指定方法，初始条件为：上方电容被充到 V，右侧电容电压为 0，电感电流为 0。开关在 t=0 投到位置 2 后，在 t=0+，电感电流不能突变，仍为 0。由于电感是两个网孔的公共支路，且通过该公共支路的相对网孔电流必须使电感电流保持为零，所以有 i1(0+) = i2(0+)。对包含位置 2 左侧电阻 R、已充电的上方电容、右侧电阻 R、以及初始未充电的右侧电容的外回路写 KVL。按图中顺时针网孔电流方向，得到 R i1 + V + R i2 + 0 = 0。代入 i2 = i1，得 2R i1 + V = 0，因此 i1(0+) = -V/(2R)。

There is no DC current in the branch where the right-side capacitor is located, and there is finally no voltage across its two ends, so the initial voltage of the right-side capacitor is 0.

After switching to position 2 at t = 0+, the capacitor voltages and inductor current cannot change abruptly. Thus the upper capacitor is equivalent to a voltage source satisfying v_A - v_B = V; the initial voltage of the right-side capacitor is 0, so it is equivalent to a short circuit; the initial current of the inductor is 0, so it is equivalent to an open circuit. At this time, node A is connected to ground through the left resistor R, and node B is connected to ground through the right resistor R. Write KCL for the supernode containing A and B: V_A/R + V_B/R = 0, and at the same time V_A - V_B = V. Solving gives V_A = V/2, V_B = -V/2. The actual current in the left resistor flows from A downward to ground, with magnitude V_A/R = V/(2R). Since the positive direction of i1 is taken as upward through the left resistor, opposite to the actual direction, i1(0+) = -V/(2R).
